newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean blue chips end lower on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Chilean blue chips end lower on profit-taking.

text.p: Chilean stocks closed lower with the market hitting a wave of profit-taking as hopes faded that the Central Bank would lower interest rates this week, said traders.
The negative tilt is seen continuing at the opening, although much will depend on the mood of foreign investors who were the main force behind Thursday's rally, they said.
The 40-share index ended down 0.85 percent at 116.08 points. The general index shed 0.42 percent to 5,338.67 points.
Trade was heavy with turnover of 23.4 billion pesos.
Traders reported investors cashing in gains in electricity stocks, which have rallied strongly in recent sessions.
Power generator Endesa, which had climbed to 270 pesos midday, ended down 1.31 percent at 264-1/2 pesos.
Winners included forestry firm Infodema, which is said to be in talks to form an alliance with wood board manufacturer Masisa, they said.
Telecom Telex rallied on hopes that the company will be able to renew its search for a foreign strategic partner following a court ruling Wednesday overturning charges of filing misleading accounts.
Telex ended up 3.67 percent at 1,130 pesos.
